summary: Risk stands at 44.73 (caution), up 0.04 on the day and 2.78 on the week, against a goldilocks backdrop. Overnight the US tape was led by semiconductors and memory: Nvidia +2.19, Micron +2.48, AMD +4.91, while crypto eased (Bitcoin -0.87, Ether -0.92, Solana -2.96). Rates drifted lower into the open (ten-year 4.7 from 4.74, ten-year real rate 2.38 from 2.4) and the dollar softened to 118.06, but the macro dimension remains the only stretched leg (real rate 2.38 at the 97.11 percentile, ten-year yield 4.7 at the 97.91 percentile). The China A-share storage chain closed soft (ChangXin -0.71, GigaDevice -0.76, Longsys -1.48, Biwin -1.96), a divergence from the US memory bid. Today's US personal income and outlays and second-quarter gross domestic product prints (both high importance) plus Nvidia earnings bracket the session.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro dimension is the only stretched leg of the risk stack, scoring 60.41 with the ten-year real rate at 2.38 (97.11 percentile) and the ten-year yield at 4.7 (97.91 percentile) anchoring rate-sensitive pressure.

Labour-market quality keeps deteriorating: non-farm payrolls printed -23.0 against a prior 20.0, continuing claims rose to 1799000, and the participation rate slipped to 61.4 even as the unemployment rate fell to 4.1.
Equity market structure is narrowing: only 0.6516 of the universe sits above the 200-day average while new highs are just 0.0323, and semiconductors relative performance is -11.8693.
The dollar is historically weak at 118.06 (16.05 percentile), a tailwind for risk assets but a sign of fragile dollar-funding confidence.

supporting_signals.claim: Overnight US semis and memory led: Nvidia +2.19, Micron +2.48, AMD +4.91, and the memory theme rose 1.1735 while the semis theme gained 2.2539.
Rates eased into the open: the ten-year fell to 4.7 from 4.74, the ten-year real rate to 2.38 from 2.4, and high-yield credit spreads tightened to 2.69 from 2.7.
Disinflation is intact: headline consumer prices printed 3.30386, core 2.46652, and the personal consumption expenditures deflator 3.28653, all below their prior reads.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility remains benign: the VIX is 15.85 and realized volatility only 13.2898, so the rate-driven caution is not yet a market-wide stress event.
Cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.5 and the trend dimension reads 44.93 with price 8.1141 percent above the 200-day average, arguing against a systemic drawdown.

what_changed_today: Risk score rose 0.04 on the day to 44.73 as the macro leg re-stretched; the 1-day and 1-week trend read 0.04 and 2.78.
China A-share storage names closed soft (ChangXin -0.71, GigaDevice -0.76, Longsys -1.48, Biwin -1.96) even as the US memory tape bid.
watch_next: Today's US personal income and outlays and second-quarter gross domestic product prints (both high importance) plus Nvidia earnings bracket the session.
The early-September employment report (high importance) is the next confirmation point for the -23.0 non-farm print.
Monitor whether the dollar at 118.06 holds or breaks lower, which would extend the risk-asset tailwind but pressure dollar-funding.

bull_case.title: Bull case: rates ease and the AI bid extends
points: If the ten-year real rate eases from 2.38 and the dollar stays soft at 118.06, the macro drag fades and the goldilocks regime holds.
Sustained semis leadership (semis +2.2539, networking +2.6062, memory +1.1735) keeps the AI infrastructure cycle intact.

base_case.title: Base case: caution within a goldilocks regime
points: Risk holds near 44.73 with the macro dimension the sole stretched leg; the 1-day trend is 0.04 and the 1-week trend 2.78.
Headline catalysts (Nvidia earnings and the high-importance income and output prints) resolve the near-term direction without changing the regime.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the macro leg breaks higher
points: If the ten-year yield pushes back above 4.7 and the real rate past 2.38, the macro dimension would re-rate toward stress and pressure equities.
A weak early-September payroll or a disappointing Nvidia print could tip breadth (0.6516 above the 200-day average) into a wider de-risking.
